title: Punctual ringed-site operations and normalized comparison predicates
statement:
Let $\mathcal T$ be the category with one object $*$ and only its identity, with the Grothendieck topology in which only the maximal sieve covers. For a commutative ring $R$, define $\underline R$ to be the constant ring sheaf with value $R$, with underlying ring value $R$, and put $\mathcal M_R=\operatorname{Mod}(\underline R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $E_R:\mathcal M_R\to\operatorname{Mod}R$ by evaluation at $*$, and $I_R$ by the constant module presheaf, whose restriction is the identity; both act on morphisms by their sole component. Evaluation has its sectionwise additive and zero-preserving structures. A ring map $\varphi:R\to S$ gives the componentwise constant ring-sheaf map $\underline\varphi$. Define $T_\varphi(M)$ and $T_\varphi(g)$ by sheaf change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and $U_\varphi$ by restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], with its additive structure. Let $V_\varphi= S\otimes_R-$ be ordinary scalar extension [def-weil-module-base-change], with its additive structure, ordinary restriction $W_\varphi$, and ordinary adjunction unit $\eta^m_M:m\mapsto1\otimes m$. Let $[s\otimes x]\in E_ST_\varphi(M)$ be the image of the sectionwise tensor under the sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification].

Define the tensor-comparison predicate to mean that there exist module isomorphisms $t_{M,N}:E_R(M\otimes_{\underline R}N)\simeq E_RM\otimes_RE_RN$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], sending each sheaf pure tensor to $x\otimes y$, natural in both module maps. Define the ordinary-unit-formula predicate by $\eta^m_M(m)=1\otimes m$. For an additive functor $F:\mathcal M_R\to\mathcal M_S$, object identifications $h_M:F(M)=T_\varphi(M)$, natural isomorphisms $s:E_SF\simeq V_\varphi E_R$ and $r:E_RU_\varphi\simeq W_\varphi E_S$, and an adjunction $a:F\dashv U_\varphi$, define scalar-unit compatibility by: $s_M([b\otimes x])=b\otimes x$ after transport along $h_M$; $r$ is the identity on sections; and $E_R(a.\mathrm{unit}_M)$ followed by $r_{F(M)}$ and $W_\varphi(s_M)$ equals $\eta^m_{E_RM}$. Define the homotopy extension and restriction comparisons by applying the given $s$ and $r$ termwise and descending to homotopy categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

For specified derived localizations of $\mathcal M_R$ and $\operatorname{Mod}R$, with localization morphisms in universe $u+1$ for rings and modules in universe $u$, define derived-localization compatibility to mean existence of an equivalence $D_R:D(\mathcal M_R)\simeq D(R)$ and a natural isomorphism $Q_sD_R\simeq E_R^KQ_m$, in diagrammatic order. For localizations at both $R$ and $S$, define the derived-scalar-comparison predicate for $(\varphi,F,s,r,a)$ as follows. Restriction $U_\varphi$ preserves finite limits and finite colimits. There exist localization-compatible equivalences $D_R,D_S$ with comparisons $k_R,k_S$, functors $L_s:D(\mathcal M_R)\to D(\mathcal M_S)$ and $L_m:D(R)\to D(S)$, natural counits $\varepsilon_s:Q_sL_s\to F^KQ'_s$ and $\varepsilon_m:Q_mL_m\to V_\varphi^KQ'_m$, natural isomorphisms $c:D_RL_m\simeq L_sD_S$ and $b:(DU_\varphi)D_R\simeq D_SW_\varphi^D$, and adjunctions $a_s:L_s\dashv DU_\varphi$, $a_m:L_m\dashv W_\varphi^D$. Each counit exhibits its functor as the universal total left derived functor of the indicated ordinary homotopy functor, meaning that composition with the counit gives the natural-transformation bijection for every test functor. The sheaf counit and the ordinary counit on its evaluated complex are invertible on every sheaf K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex]. The square comparing $\varepsilon_s$ and $\varepsilon_m$ through $c$, $k_R$, $k_S$ and the termwise comparison $s^K$ commutes at every homotopy object. The isomorphism $b$ is exactly the localization of $r^K$ using $k_R,k_S$ and the canonical restriction-localization comparisons. On each sheaf K-flat representative, the unit of $a_s$ followed by restriction of $\varepsilon_s$ and its localization comparison equals the localization of the degreewise unit of $a$. On each ordinary K-flat representative [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], the corresponding equation for $a_m,\varepsilon_m$ is the localization of the ordinary degreewise unit $m\mapsto1\otimes m$. Finally, at every derived object $K$, $D_R(a_s.\mathrm{unit}_K)$ followed by $b_{L_sK}$ equals $a_m.\mathrm{unit}_{D_RK}$ followed by $W_\varphi^D(c_K)$. These are definitions of constructions and predicates, with no assertion that the comparison predicates hold.
